(async()=>{const b='';const z=Uint8Array.from(atob(b),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const p=JSON.parse(await new Response(new Blob([z]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text());const r=await fetch('/api/internal/coordination/v2/runtime-releases',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},credentials:'same-origin',body:JSON.stringify(p)});console.log('HTTP',r.status,await r.json());})().catch(console.error);
